value.signature: fn replay (p : & Procedure , input : & Inputs , record : & Record) -> Result < CheckedRidge , Error >

review.body: { let checked = run (p , input , Some (record)) ? ; Ok (CheckedRidge { procedure : p . clone () , input : input . clone () , image : checked . image , }) }
review.item_premise: The fixed public definition and complete independently checked evidence are retained. Replay rebuilds every query and box; checked immutable image access supplies no additional authority. No price, secret or admission transition occurs.
